pi.label: Operational Coherence (π)
pi.description: Chain-average balance score across all 10 epochs. Measures how consistently each paradigm maintained D-C equilibrium during its active period.

current.label: Historical Record
current.description: N-values derived from the historical record of each epoch

optimum.label: Full Archive Access
optimum.description: What N-values would look like with complete primary source access for all epochs

shock_1.label: Paradigm Crisis Stress
shock_1.description: Effect of a major paradigm-invalidating crisis on N (simulates 1929 or 2008 scale event) at Phase 5 onward

shock_2.label: Archive Loss Scenario
shock_2.description: Effect of major archive destruction or opacity on early phases (like loss of Roman library at Alexandria)

expansion.label: Open Science Scenario
expansion.description: Full open access to all academic publishing, central bank data, and historical archives across all epochs

regulatory.label: Institutional Anchoring
regulatory.description: What happens when institutional D constraints are strengthened in phases 8 and 9 (more regulation, data transparency)

phi.label: Proportional Balance (φ)
phi.description: Golden ratio test: how close is each epoch's D/C ratio to φ = 1.618? Epochs near this ratio show optimal intellectual leverage.

sqrt2.label: Structural Coherence (√2)
sqrt2.description: Inter-phase coupling strength. How much does each epoch's N depend on the prior epoch's C outputs? Measures the chain's structural integrity.

ln2.label: Growth and Transformation (ln 2)
ln2.description: Paradigm transformation efficiency. How much intellectual capital is preserved and amplified across each phase transition?

current.label: Historical Record
current.description: Transformation efficiency estimated from phase interaction d_coupling and c_coupling

e.label: Abstract Layer (e)
e.description: Financial and abstract leverage ratio. For the economics history model this represents the degree to which economic theory has been captured by financial abstraction rather than grounded in physical production.
e.note: The e-layer score is 0 (unmeasured) for the history of economic thought model. Activating this layer would require modeling the feedback loop between financial theory and financial market growth, which belongs in the value chain layer not the supply chain layer.
